title: Brand Voice Profile
description: One brand's writing voice, as data. A marketer fills this in -- no code, no engineer -- and it becomes selectable wherever a target profile (ICP) is configured. src/outreach/brand_voice.py is the only code that reads this file.

id.description: Must exactly match the filename (without .yaml). Lowercase, words separated by a hyphen. This is what an ICP's brand_voice_id points at.

brand_name.description: The name shown in the picker in the app, e.g. 'Lake B2B'.

max_sentences.description: Hard cap on sentences per comment. Most LinkedIn comments read best at 1-2.

emoji_frequency.description: How often an emoji is allowed to show up.

banned_phrases.description: Words or phrases this brand should never write. Case-insensitive.

preferred_phrases.description: Optional. Words or phrases that sound like this brand, used only where they fit naturally -- never forced into every comment.

tone_words.description: Optional. 2-5 adjectives that describe the voice, e.g. 'direct', 'warm', 'no-fluff'.

cta_style.description: Optional. How a comment is allowed to end. Defaults to soft_question.

signoff.description: Optional. Whether to address the person by first name. Defaults to none.

notes.description: Optional. Anything else in your own words -- 'never mention competitor names', 'always assume the reader is technical', etc.

example_comments.description: At least 2 real examples of this brand's voice. These are shown to the writer as style references, never copied verbatim.

post_context.description: One line describing the kind of post this was replying to.

comment.description: The actual example comment, written the way this brand would write it.
